_context.agentPicker.open: A chip under a message of the workspace assistant: opens one screen of a coworker. The words after Open are the names of the coworker's tabs.
_context.event.schedules: A badge on the card that says a coworker finished its setup: how many schedules are turned on.
_context.event.triggers: A badge on the card that says a coworker finished its setup: how many triggers are turned on.
_context.skill.ask: A coworker offers to remember a rule it learned in the conversation.
_context.table.partial: How many rows of a table a card shows, out of the table's total.
